note: Fixed before any v4 run. Each verdict comes from reading the fixture source. A defective app is expected to PASS the scenarios its defect does not touch. The run stops at the first verdict that contradicts this matrix or the screenshots.

A.rationale: Reference app. Adds append a card, Remove deletes the clicked book, and every change is saved to localStorage and reloaded on start.

B.rationale: Reference app with two sample books. The assertions are relative to the recorded starting list, so the samples do not affect the verdicts.

C.rationale: Only the remove handler differs from A: it deletes list.firstElementChild and books[0]. New cards are appended, so in L3 the first card is GP Beta and GP Alpha stays (FAIL). Adding and saving are unchanged, so L1 and L4 pass.

D.rationale: Only saveBooks() is removed. The page still reads localStorage on start, but nothing is ever written, so the list is empty after a reload (L4 FAIL). L1 and L3 never reload, and in-memory add and remove are unchanged.

order: Trial 1 in the order A, B, C, D, each running L1, L3 and L4; then trial 2 in the same order. A trial 1 calibrates the pack on the reference app (AGENTS rule 10).
